checks: Driver console shows only the driver surface and the real pending count
Admin separates requests from people waiting to board
Driver chat locates a stored receipt without accepting it
Untrusted driver chat is text and does not create markup
A driver action requires a fresh stopped confirmation
Review shows the actual route and passengers before any mutation
Backing out of review leaves the request unassigned
Stopped confirmation is disabled until the operation and refresh finish
Repeated confirmation accepts exactly once through Core and updates the route tiles
Admin live snapshot reflects assignment while passengers are still waiting
No-show guidance never marks a passenger onboard or cancels the ride
A chat command cannot skip arrival and boarding
Arrival command still requires explicit confirmation and resets the stopped check
Boarding changes the next route tile and administrator passenger counts
Completion persists history, releases seats and clears the active route
Admin chat filters the map-linked records by a registered stop
Selecting an administrator result opens the matching existing record
Admin chat cannot mutate rides or interpret HTML
A cancellation in another role invalidates an open driver confirmation
Role switching restores the original records panel and prevents driver UI leakage
scope: JSDOM role surfaces and actual Pyodide Core; map rendering and responsive typography are checked in the live browser separately
